attackers_goals: The attacker's goal is to establish a persistent, high-privilege backdoor by forcing the service to load a malicious configuration that enables remote code execution and the bypass of security controls like MFA.
description: The AD FS service configuration file was modified.
investigative_actions: Check if the AD FS service was stopped or restarted around the time of modification. Investigate the process and user that performed the write operation for signs of compromise.
name: Modification of the AD FS IdentityServer configuration file
required_data: XDR Agent with eXtended Threat Hunting (XTH)
